prior_matrix.identity: Eross, McGroarty, Urquhart and Wolfe, The Intraday Dynamics of Bitcoin, Research in International Business and Finance 49, 2019, DOI 10.1016/j.ribaf.2019.01.008
prior_matrix.finding: The GMT-timestamped single-exchange study reports intraday structure and identifies its strongest return interval around 08:00 to 16:00 while activity and liquidity align with European and North American market hours.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The sample predates the sealed 2019-2024 OKX corpus, is not a matched-capital strategy test and does not establish persistence after daily fees and adverse slippage.

prior_matrix.identity: Baur, Cahill, Godfrey and Liu, Bitcoin time-of-day, day-of-week and month-of-year effects in returns and trading volume, Finance Research Letters 31, 2019, DOI 10.1016/j.frl.2019.04.023
prior_matrix.finding: Across more than fifteen million observations from seven exchanges, time-specific return anomalies were not persistent across time even though activity patterns were more stable.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: This does not prove failure on OKX, but requires annual breadth, neighboring-window stability and permanent closure rather than selecting a favorable session after outcome access.

prior_matrix.identity: Su, Wang and Yuan, The intraday dynamics and intraday price discovery of Bitcoin, Research in International Business and Finance 62, 2022, DOI 10.1016/j.ribaf.2022.101625
prior_matrix.finding: The multi-rate study reports that overlapping London and New York hours dominate intraday Bitcoin price discovery and have elevated activity, volatility and liquidity.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Price discovery and activity do not imply a positive tradable return premium. The present experiment must pay two-sided costs every day and cannot infer alpha from liquidity.

prior_matrix.identity: Catania and Sandholdt, Bitcoin at High Frequency, Journal of Risk and Financial Management 12(1), 2019, DOI 10.3390/jrfm12010036
prior_matrix.finding: The authors find smooth intraday seasonality but emphasize that return predictability is time-varying and venue activity patterns differ between Bitstamp and Coinbase.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: A fixed clock window must generalize across Design, Validation, years and one-hour shifts; venue or subperiod variation cannot be hidden.

prior_matrix.identity: Anghel, A reality check on trading rule performance in the cryptocurrency market: Machine Learning vs. Technical Analysis, Finance Research Letters 39, 2021, DOI 10.1016/j.frl.2020.101655
prior_matrix.finding: After data-snooping, risk and friction controls, positive excess returns from cryptocurrency trading rules were rare.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: This requires pre-outcome session boundaries, normal and stress costs, matched capital, path risk and no post-result timezone rescue.

executable_data_path_proof.decision_feature: The UTC hour is known before every fill. Buy at the fixed session-start H1 open and sell at the fixed session-end H1 open without using price, volume or future data.
executable_data_path_proof.prospective_transport: The existing sealed OKX BTC-USDT H1 corpus contains every required timestamp and price. No credential, paid API, timer, writer, database, manual export or backfill is required.

independence_from_closed_families: The closed DRA US-session family gates DRA entries using prior-day 15:00-20:59 UTC quote-volume share; this policy ignores DRA and volume and instead holds BTC during one fixed daily interval.
The closed weekend and turn-of-month families select dates; this policy trades every complete UTC day and selects only a fixed within-day clock interval.
The closed intraday sign-persistence family computes a lagged path statistic before a DRA entry; this policy has no return lookback or signal state.
The closed trend, oscillator, volatility and band families depend on price-derived states; this policy is known from the clock alone.
real_time_design_requirements: Use every complete H1 bar in the sealed 2019-2024 corpus without selecting a day, direction or regime.
Primary buys full available equity at each 08:00 UTC open and sells all at the same day's 16:00 UTC open.
Rejection-only stability windows are 07:00-15:00 UTC and 09:00-17:00 UTC. They cannot replace a failed primary.
Charge 0.10 percent fee plus 0.05 percent adverse slippage per side in NORMAL and twice both amounts in STRESS.
Compare with full-capital BTC buy-and-hold under the same initial capital, hourly path and valuation boundary.
Report realized, unrealized and total return, drawdown, underwater duration, Calmar, upside capture, exposure, turnover, episode concentration, annual breadth and terminal inventory.
uncertainty: Supportive evidence is largely older, venue-specific and not an after-cost trading test.
The broadest cited study finds no persistent return pattern across years.
Two-sided daily fees and adverse slippage may dominate a small session return premium.
Historical Design and Validation through 2024 cannot establish independent OOS value or activation authority.
claim_boundary: This prior authorizes exactly one preregistered 08:00-16:00 UTC historical screen with two one-hour rejection-only neighbors. It does not establish alpha, a candidate, OOS value, deployability or Trading authority.
